about: One place that says which JSONL ledgers may be rotated and how far back each keeps. First matching rule wins, so the protect rules come first. A ledger no rule names is never touched. Old lines go to ~/.claude/ledger-archive/<path>/<YYYY-MM>.jsonl.gz, never deleted. Run: python3 ~/.claude/scripts/ledger/ledger-prune.py plan
